text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2023.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 23 Disember 2023

hingga 27 Disember 2023.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing biri-biri bertulang import

2. Kepak ayam

3. Lada benggala hijau

4. Lobak merah

5. Cili merah

6. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

7. Babi hidup

8. Daging babi (perut)

9. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 14 Disember 2023

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld.8; PN(PU2)188/JLD. 13]

DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2023.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 23 December 2023 to 27 December 2023.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported bone-in mutton

2. Chicken wing

3. Green capsicum

4. Carrot

5. Red chilli

6. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

7. Live pig

8. Pork (belly)

9. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 14 December 2023

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld.8; PN(PU2)188/JLD. 13]

DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
